content.title: Sidemen Charity Match 2026: Kick-off time, FREE live stream and CONFIRMED teams for star-studded Wembley showdown
content.text: MILLIONS of pounds will hopefully get raised TODAY as the Sidemen put on their annual charity match – and there will be a big change! The YouTube Allstars beat the Sidemen on penalties in front of a sold-out 90,000 crowd following a thrilling 9-9 draw last year. Sign up for the Sport newsletter Thank you! KSI and Co have been organising the Sidemen Charity Match since 2016 Credit: Alamy YouTube Allstars won the last edition of the annual charity match Credit: Instagram @sidemen But more importantly, the huge match raised more than £4.7million for charity after tickets sold out in just THREE hours. KSI and Co have been organising the annual football game since 2016 but the seventh edition is set to be even more special. For the first time ever, the Sidemen will split up and play on opposite teams, making it a little more intriguing. Meaning it could be tougher for the hosts to bounce back from last year’s defeat and build on their 4-2 winning record. SunSport has all the key information needed for this mouthwatering match below. When is the Sidemen Charity Match 2026? This year’s Sidemen Charity Match will take place TODAY – Saturday, April 18. It is scheduled to get underway at 3pm BST/10am ET. Wembley Stadium is once again the chosen venue for this huge annual charity match and it can host a whopping 90,000 fans. The YouTube Allstars beat the Sidemen 5-4 on penalties last time out. How can I watch the Sidemen Charity Match 2026 for free? The Sidemen Charity Match has been shown via a live stream on the Sidemen YouTube channel for free in previous years – and that will be the same this year! Alternatively, SunSport will have minute-by-minute coverage of the entire match plus pre-match build-up and post-match reaction. What are the teams for the Sidemen Charity Match 2026? As mentioned, the Sidemen team that amasses six BILLION views globally on their YouTube channel will NOT all be on the same side.
